description: Scaffold the frontend Vite+React+TS project and implement all utility functions and their unit tests: aestheticScore (pure function with vitest tests), bugParser, and localStorage helpers. Also implement the PoetryTypeSelector, InputPanel, PoemDisplay, and PoetryHistory components, plus App.tsx and all CSS. This feature is independent of FEAT-001 at the code level (it does not import backend code), but the API contract is defined in FEAT-001's steps so implement FEAT-002 after FEAT-001.

Create /Users/lndu/Documents/BugPoet/frontend/src/utils/aestheticScore.ts as a pure module with NO imports: (a) function countStackLines(text: string): number — count lines matching /^\s+at |File "|\tat |line \d+/m patterns using text.split('\n').filter(l => ...).length; (b) function hasRepeatedLines(text: string): boolean — split to lines, filter non-empty, use Map to count occurrences, return true if any line appears >= 3 times; (c) export function calcAestheticScore(errorText: string): number — score=0; score += Math.min(40, Math.floor(errorText.length/50)); score += Math.min(30, countStackLines(errorText)*2); if(hasRepeatedLines(errorText)) score+=10; if(/Error|Exception/i.test(errorText)) score+=10; if(/fatal|crash|segfault|SIGSEGV|killed/i.test(errorText)) score+=15; if(/warning/i.test(errorText)) score-=5; return Math.max(0,Math.min(100,score)); (d) export function getScoreLabel(score: number): string — <=30:'小病呻吟', <=70:'黯然神伤', else:'肝肠寸断'.

Create /Users/lndu/Documents/BugPoet/frontend/src/__tests__/aestheticScore.test.ts with vitest tests (import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest'). Tests: (1) empty string returns 0; (2) calcAestheticScore('') === 0; (3) string with only 'warning' returns 0 (5-5=0 floored); (4) 'NullPointerException' includes Error keyword: score >= 10; (5) string with 'fatal error' returns score >= 15; (6) string of 2000 chars: length component is 40; (7) text with 15 stack lines matching /^\s+at /: stack component is 30; (8) text with a line repeated 3 times: +10; (9) getScoreLabel(0) === '小病呻吟'; (10) getScoreLabel(30) === '小病呻吟'; (11) getScoreLabel(31) === '黯然神伤'; (12) getScoreLabel(70) === '黯然神伤'; (13) getScoreLabel(71) === '肝肠寸断'; (14) getScoreLabel(100) === '肝肠寸断'; (15) score is always in [0,100] — test with very long text and all keywords.
